messages:
Maya (AE): Opening RavenBridge POC thread. Prospect wants a near-zero client change migration from their current vendor. Key asks: strict parity for three compliance prompts, per-request billing trace, SSO + BYOK, and a short smoke in our sandbox. SE + Sec + Pricing pls advise.

Jon (SE): Quick notes: They currently call /v1/complete sync, ~480k tokens/day, avg prompt 70 tokens. Biggest risks: tokenizer differences causing token billing deltas and nondeterministic outputs for compliance templates. Plan: provide adapter example, run parity harness (golden exact-match, token delta, semantic sim), and produce per-request token traces for reconciliation.

Pri (RavenBridge Eng): We have 3 legal templates that must be identical. We'll share 150 golden prompts + 500-sample set. Need sandbox IP allowlist and a shim so we don't change many clients.

Jon (SE): Adapter one-liner:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/responses \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"input":"{{prompt}}","model":"redwood-stable-1"}'
```
We will run a 200-prompt smoke tonight, then the full 650+ set during POC week. We'll include tokenizer side-by-side outputs and a reconciliation report.

Rohit (Security): BYOK/KMS supported on Dedicated and Private. Hosted uses envelope encryption; hosted BYOK not available. SSO/SCIM: supported for console. Default audit log retention is 90d (masked) and can be extended on Dedicated via contract. We'll need the prospect to fill our vendor security questionnaire; I can prefill common answers and flag BYOK SLA + retention items.

Mina (Pricing): Quick ballpark: hosted gen $0.0065 / 1k tokens. Dedicated estimate for their volume ~ $38k/month (6mo term); 12mo discounts available. Onboarding fee for Private + PS for KMS automation may apply. I'll prepare two scenarios once they share invoices.

Pri (RavenBridge Eng): Acceptance criteria from our side: 1) 3 golden templates -> exact byte-for-byte match. 2) Token accounting delta <=2% across 2k prompts. 3) Semantic sim >=0.95 for non-deterministic set. 4) Per-request trace available for reconciliation. 5) p95 latency <300ms on Dedicated for short prompts. 6) No silent truncation on retries.

Jon (SE): We'll provide the adapter repo and a small runbook (clone, set REDWOOD_KEY, run ./smoke.sh --sample 200). Staging sandbox will be shared in follow-up with IPs.

Maya (AE): Scheduling 30m kickoff with RavenBridge + SE + Sec + Pricing tomorrow 9:30am PT. Agenda: parity scope, security questionnaire, pricing scenarios, and allowlisting. Marking CRM: ravenbridge-swap-poc.

Pri (RavenBridge Eng): If we get the harness tonight we can start the smoke.

Jon (SE): Will drop repo link and runbook after this thread. :thumbsup:
